prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic fine-art fashion portrait of one original approved adult man in a monochrome sky-blue studio.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult man with tousled dark hair, calm detached gaze and natural skin texture. He stands frontally with shoulders down and hands in pockets, wearing a monochrome sky-blue suit and white shirt while holding a supplied transparent glass ball as a symbol of control and the future.
composition_elements: Vertical editorial portrait with centered frontal stance, hands in pockets and glass ball held low in one hand.
Minimalist sky-blue studio background with clean negative space and controlled cool palette.
Preserve suit geometry, white shirt, glass ball, calm expression and subtle leather/white accent palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic directional key light with soft fill, geometric highlights on the suit and glass ball, cool atmospheric shadows and quiet technological mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, Hasselblad X2D with XCD 80mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field focused on face and prop, realistic wool, glass and skin texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
